title: Mkomazi National Park and Its Rhino Sanctuary
excerpt: Mkomazi National Park lies in the dry northeast, below the Usambara and Pare mountains. Known for its rhino sanctuary and wild dog programme.
body:
Mkomazi National Park borders Kenya's Tsavo West and lies between Kilimanjaro and the Usambara Mountains. It is quiet, dry and beautiful.

## The rhino sanctuary

Within Mkomazi there is a fenced sanctuary for black rhinos, managed as part of a conservation programme. Visits to the sanctuary are possible only on certain terms; ask us what is possible.

## Wild dogs

Mkomazi is also known for a breeding programme for African wild dogs, which have been reintroduced in the area.

## Wildlife

Giraffes, elephants, zebras, gerenuk, lesser kudu, oryx and many dry-country birds.

## Why visit

- Quiet game drives.
- Combination with the [Usambara Mountains](/blog/usambara-mountains-lushoto/) and the coast.

## Getting there

By road from Moshi or Arusha, about three to four hours.

See our [10-day Mkomazi, Usambara and Saadani trip](/itineraries/10-days-safari-mkomazi-usambara-mountains-saadani-with-beach-relaxation/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
